provenance: arXiv e-print ancillary file anc/Table_Var_Xsec.csv (40 blocks = 8 kinematic variables x 5 targets; each block: bin edges, measured sigma, Abs. Unc., and separate statistical and systematic NxN covariance matrices). Abs. Unc. = sqrt(diag(stat_cov)+diag(sys_cov)) (verified, max deviation < 1.2% from table rounding); flux-normalization fractional uncertainty is quoted separately per-bin in the table but is NOT part of Abs. Unc. or the two covariance matrices (it mostly cancels in the paper's target-ratio measurements, hence reported apart) so it is excluded here to match the paper's own headline uncertainty. Target labels: scintillator=CH (per-nucleon on the CH tracker, includes free-proton H), carbon/water/iron/lead are passive nuclear targets (per-nucleon).
